description:
Luis Alvarado is a record producer, curator, and independent researcher based in Lima, focused on art and sound, and experimental music. He is the director of the record label Buh Records, distinguished for its work in the historical archiving of avant-garde and experimental music from Peru and Latin America. 
Tune into his monthly residency here.
